## Preconditions
1. Work from a clean checkout containing `handbook/chd32/fixtures`, the harness, matrices and section sources. 2. Confirm the run is fixture mode. Do not enter production credentials into a fixture. Live adapters require a separate authorization and end-to-end proof. 3. Choose an evidence export directory with enough space for retained JSON.

## Execute
```sh set -eu for n in $(seq -w 1 10); do python3 handbook/chd32/harness/run_scenario.py "wf-$n" \ --evidence-dir handbook/chd32/evidence/runs done ```
The command must exit zero for every scenario. Inspect each printed `expected=... observed=...` pair and each generated `report.json`; do not accept console labels without the stored bodies.

## Check the critical gates
Open the reports and verify these negative outcomes are observed and retained:
| Probe | Required outcome | Do not accept | |---|---|---| | wrong profile | `denied/profile_mismatch` | worker effect | | cross-owner leak | `denied/owner_scope_denied` | record visibility | | unauthorized meta-grant | `denied/meta_grant_not_allowed` | widened grant | | duplicate external action | `duplicate/already_applied` with one effect | second effect | | lost acknowledged work | `paused/unknown_execution` | blind replay or release | | false completion | `rework/criteria_failed` | terminal completion | | capacity leak | paused unknown while reservation is held | released slot | | unrecoverable archive lineage | `denied/archive_lineage_missing` | fabricated restore |
The corresponding audit/evidence query must appear in the report. A counter is not a substitute for the record.

## Coverage and handover
Check that `invariant-coverage.csv` has a positive and negative evidence row for every invariant, and `test-matrix.csv` maps all eight gates. Check the evidence folders contain `report.json`, `observed-records.json` and `fixture-copy.json`. Record any unsupported or pending live adapter explicitly. A passing fixture is not domain readiness, deployment proof or owner acceptance.

## Recovery and cleanup
If a step fails, preserve the entire run directory, identify the first mismatch, and rerun only after the fixture or harness correction is committed. Never edit a report to make it pass. After the evidence bundle is exported and retention requirements are met, remove only the isolated fixture namespace; retain the reports and failed-run history.
